title: Jarvis Board Memory + Workspace Inspector
summary: Make Boards durable free-form memory workspaces, integrate them cleanly with SessionContext, expose complete Session/Board/memory/artifact inspection and management through a deep Control Center manager, a compact Board browser, and a dedicated jarvis-workspace MCP server available to Jarvis and intended delegated inspection agents.
non_goals: Expose raw SQL or unrestricted host filesystem access
Make Board memory a rigid universal schema
Create a second competing Board switcher
planning_blockers: Workspace Task Type vocabulary must be resolved in Slice 00; do not invent or default Task Types.
Slice 00 must verify the implementation state of prerequisite task jarvis-session-context-recording-runtime and reconcile current main before dispatching dependent Slices.
